items.title: Wayne Bergeron interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, December 29, 2020
items.q: Whenever I play with him, we play in Dave Slonaker’s band and we played on several recordings together.

ctx.x: except that if you’re just on this date for one gig how long does it take you to figure out where the drummer is at?

Not very long at all. I just answered this question for somebody else the other day. They were asking me about what I — and I try to go to where — because to get the drummer to budge it’s going to be more difficult. You know? So because here’s the beat and here’s the front half of the beat and here’s the back half of the beat. This is all correct. Right? And so some drummers play, you know like when they’re playing quarter notes they go [scats] so that middle note of the shuffle [scats] some drummers play it on…
be. On Pat Williams’ record man, we have a bunch of stuff like that. And we always look over and smile. I always look at him and go yeah. We have a little connection you know.
